item.title: California gas prices have long plagued Democratic candidates. This year is different
item.description: Gas prices in California continue to be the highest in the nation, but the war in Iran has given California Democrats a rare opportunity to turn the tables on the issue.

item.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. Six in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

item.title: Putin releases American Stephen Hubbard from Russian prison
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has freed another American, 74-year-old Michigan native Stephen Hubbard, from a Russian prison following a request from President Trump.

item.title: Vivek Ramaswamy's attack ad features mother of Amy Acton, who alleges childhood abuse
item.description: A campaign ad by Republican candidate for Ohio governor Vivek Ramaswamy includes the mother of Democrat Amy Acton. Acton says they've been estranged since she was abused as a child by her stepfather.
